promises.label: Achieve eCommerce profitability
promises.commitment: Improve digital margins with the goal of eCommerce profitability; no deadline was given.
promises.outcomeSummary: Reported first-time quarterly eCommerce profitability in Q1 for the U.S. and global enterprise, helped by lower delivery costs, advertising and membership.

missing.what_was_said: Alongside the break-even outlook including advertising and fulfillment services, management also aimed for eCommerce profitability without those additional contributions, describing that ambition as further down the road.

Management clarified that U.S. and Sam's Club eCommerce were profitable, while International was slightly unprofitable. Global enterprise profitability referred to the combined result, not profitability in every segment.

promises.label: Close the VIZIO acquisition
promises.commitment: Close the VIZIO acquisition during FY2025.
promises.outcomeSummary: Walmart completed the VIZIO acquisition on Dec. 3, 2024, within fiscal year 2025 as promised.

missing.what_was_said: Management acknowledged VIZIO's addition to Walmart, saying, “We're really excited about having the VIZIO team join Walmart and what that new platform will do for our customers.” This provided subsequent earnings-call confirmation of delivery.

promises.label: Make VIZIO acquisition accretive
promises.commitment: Begin making the VIZIO transaction accretive to Walmart next year.
promises.outcomeSummary: Accretion was not publicly confirmed. The original next-year expectation remained unmodified; subsequent earnings calls discussed advertising growth and integration without confirming transaction-level earnings accretion.
